notes.title: Patch 1.18.6
notes.content: Patch 1.18.6 contains a fix for an issue causing Campaign progress to be reset between launches. Users who experienced this issue will have their progress restored.

notes.title: Yellow & Yangtze Patch 1.18
notes.content:
A new patch is now available for [i]Yellow & Yangtze[/i], with bug fixes, quality of life improvements, and more time to strategize in multiplayer games!

Check out the [url=https://www.direwolfdigital.com/news/yellow-yangtze-patch-1-18/]full patch notes [b]here[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Yellow & Yangtze – Learning to Strategize
notes.content:
[i]Reiner Knizia’s Yellow & Yangtze[/i] is now available on Steam, iTunes, and Google Play! Get a head start on founding your own dynasty with these [url=https://www.direwolfdigital.com/news/yellow-and-yangtze-strategy/][b]strategy tips and tricks[/b][/url] that will elevate your empire to greatness!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35898273/d1d497556858c1746471dae363aabb0266614151.png[/img]

notes.title: Reiner Knizia’s Yellow & Yangtze is Live!
notes.content:
[i]Reiner Knizia’s Yellow & Yangtze[/i] is live today, going cross-platform on Steam, iTunes, and Google Play with a number of [url=https://www.direwolfdigital.com/news/reiner-knizias-yellow-yangtze-is-live/]new features and improvements![/url]
